items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023

ctx.x: And could be thought of I guess is the best way I can put it.

Yeah. Mahler too. I had all those scores before any of my Mahler scores. “The Rite of Spring” I had since I went to Berklee and I used to listen to the recordings and I could not figure it out. The music I — but the orchestration — how? And it was Mahler who, when I came back to “The Rite of Spring” well of course, it’s a science you know. It’s like mathematics and there it is. Rimsky-Korsakov teaching Stravinsky.
Well where does Frank Zappa fit in there?
